questions.q: What do the authors say separates a star athlete from the rest of the team?
questions.why: Everyone has potential, but winners are the ones who truly want to win.

questions.q: Which two qualities does desire produce?
questions.why: Commitment keeps you focused while perseverance carries you through hard times.

questions.q: What example does the summary give of a well-defined goal?
questions.why: A specific target is easier to plan for than a vague wish for more money.

questions.q: What signs indicate a good mentor?
a: Selfless, trustworthy, honest, and glad to see others succeed
Wealthy, famous, well connected, and busy
Older, strict, highly educated, and reserved
Optimistic, talkative, friendly, and easy to please
questions.why: The summary also suggests looking at the health of a person's relationships.

questions.q: What three parts of yourself does the summary say you must nurture?
questions.why: Neglecting any one of them limits what you can accomplish.
